simple.meaning: לוּשׁ (lûwsh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to knead.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Genesis, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, Jeremiah, Hosea, beginning at Genesis 18:6. Its contexts include family, offering, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לוּשׁ (H3888).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: לוּשׁ (lûwsh) / H3888 is traced through Genesis 18:6, 1 Samuel 28:24, 2 Samuel 13:8, Jeremiah 7:18 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs* 1 seah is about 7 liters or 1.9 gallons or 0.8 pecks of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
